description: This file defines functions for creating and logging network cache disk cache log parameters, including data read/write, completion, sparse operations, and range results, with external dependencies on net and base libraries.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteDataParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of parameters for a read/write data log entry.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteCompleteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of parameters for a read/write completion log entry.

methods.name: NetLogSparseOperationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of parameters for a sparse operation log entry.

methods.name: NetLogSparseReadWriteParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of parameters for a sparse read/write log entry.

methods.name: CreateNetLogParametersEntryCreationParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with key and creation status for a cache entry.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteData
methods.description: Logs a data read/write event with specified parameters.

methods.name: NetLogReadWriteComplete
methods.description: Logs a completion event for data transfer.

methods.name: CreateNetLogGetAvailableRangeResultParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary representing the result of an available range query.
